title: Direct quotes
description: data/quotes.yaml: section 11, one entry per table row, in document order.

oneOf.description: A rule ID, or `Master` for the master rule (meta.master_rule), as in edition 6.

rules.description: Rules the quote supports (IDs named in the Rule cell; `Master` for the master rule).

source.description: First (main) source of the row. Null only on a placeholder row without a link.

text.description: The Direct quote cell verbatim: quoted text with its attributions and inline locators.

locator.description: Locator for the whole row. Edition 9 gives no row locators, so it is null throughout 1.0.0; inline locators ("para 1-45", "principle 7") stay in `text`.

placeholder.description: Optional. Present (true) on a row whose text states that no quote exists ("no new quote", "no management source found", ...).

rule_label.description: Optional. Verbatim Rule cell when it is not the `, `-joined `rules`.

extra_sources.description: Optional. Further sources of the row, in cell order.

source_titles.description: Per-use link-title overrides: slug -> the title this cell uses when it differs from sources.yaml `title`. Renderers use it instead of the canonical title for this use only.

sources_text.description: Optional. The Sources cell with `[@slug]` citations when it is not just the `; `-joined citations.
